messages:
maria: quick question—are we okay changing /rank API tie-break default? clients assume stable ordering by input index.
akash: we discussed in arch sync; default today is tie_break: 'none' meaning stable by server insertion order, which isn't guaranteed across sharding.
ben: important: some downstream consumer relies on deterministic sort to cache results. breaking it would require migration.
ciara: proposal: make server guarantee deterministic ordering by (score desc, input_index asc) when scores equal. Add explicit field in resp: "tie_resolved_by": "index".
maria: sgtm. what's the behavior for null/NaN scores? should null be treated as lowest or omitted items dropped?
akash: current impl returns null score for unknowns. I think we should treat null as -inf when sorting, but also preserve them in output.
ben: +1 for preserving. clients might rely on same item set length. But we should document that nulls sort to bottom.
ciara: also update request schema to allow optional "tie_break": "index|id|random" and server default to "index" for backward compat.
maria: example response snippet:
```json
{"results": [{"id":"a1","score":0.823},{"id":"b2","score":0.823,"tie_resolved_by":"index"},{"id":"c3","score":null}]}
```
ben: small nit: use "tie_break_applied": true boolean instead of string? easier to parse.
akash: hmm i'd keep both: expose the applied policy via header `x-rank-tie` and per-item `tie_resolved_by` when relevant.
ciara: backwards compat: legacy clients ignore extra fields so adding tie_resolved_by is safe. But changing default sort semantics is not. we must roll this behind a flag for 2 releases.
maria: ok plan: 1) add field docs + header, 2) implement deterministic (index) but gate behind header `X-Rank-Contract: v2` and 3) release deprecation note and 30d opt-in before enforcing.
ben: please create a short API note + migration snippet, i'll review.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for feature/contract-tie-break (PR #4127)
akash: thx, @ben pinged you the doc PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/contract-notes/4127
maria: thanks all. i'll add to release checklist and set reminder to announce in #announcements.
